content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The accounting-themed receipt gives the page character, but oversized audience labels and repeated information make the mobile page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The typographic hero and receipt illustration feel tailored to an accountant, but the service list and contact details are repeated further down.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "On phones, replace the three oversized audience blocks with a compact list and reduce their vertical padding.",
    "Keep the receipt as the hero’s service summary, but make the later services section expandable so it does not repeat another full list by default.",
    "Keep the prominent contact section and simplify the footer to legal details and navigation, removing its second address, phone and email block."
  ]
}
